rounds: Two weeks of holding the line on routine — that's not nothing, that's actually a win. The Apollo ring made it to work on the finger, which means you wore it. But when someone noticed and asked? You folded. The ring said yes, your mouth said 'don't look at me.'
pattern: They're fine with the object, terrified of the conversation.
focus: Next time someone asks about the ring — say one true thing.
